messages:
olivia: heads up — the onboarding sampleapp is creating duplicate background jobs when customers hit intermittent 429s. Repro steps in thread below :grimacing:

sam: ouch. do you have a minimal log snippet? is it retries doubling or replaying the original POST?

olivia: logs show client got a 429, SDK retried the request after jitter, and the app processed the job twice. sequence:
```
POST /v1/tasks  -> 429 rate_limited
client sdk: refresh token (async)
client sdk: retry POST without idempotency header -> 200 created
server processed both attempts (no dedupe key)
```

kevin: hmm token refresh in the middle of a retry sounds like a race. are we queuing the retry after refresh or firing both?

olivia: looks like both — refresh happens on a separate promise and the retry path doesn't wait for the refresh to finish, so the same logical request can be sent twice.

maria: for quick mitigation we should: 1) set a default idempotency header in our sampleapp for POST-like endpoints, 2) nudge SDK default backoff to be a bit more conservative, and 3) make the retry wait for token refresh resolution.

sam: agree. proposal for SDK defaults: exponential backoff base=1.6, max_backoff=10s, jitter=0.35, and only N retries for 429/5xx (3 by default). also treat token-refresh as a retry gate.

kevin: sounds reasonable. one question: do we want the SDK to auto-generate idempotency keys for users if they don't supply one? pros: protects naive apps; cons: might hide semantics if callers expect multiple creates. maybe opt-in via a config flag (safe_replay_protection=true) and sampleapp enables it.

olivia: opt-in is fine, but sampleapp should enable it so onboarding doesn't hit this mismatch. can we add a sampleapp section in README explaining idempotency headers and show code?

sam: I'll add quick patch: sampleapp will set X-Idempotency-Key from uuid per high-level operation. snippet:
```
const id = uuid.v4();
fetch('/v1/tasks', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'X-Idempotency-Key': id } });
```

maria: also add a note about async token refresh race and a recommended pattern: single in-flight token refresh promise that other calls await. super common pattern.

kevin: created MR in SDK repo with the retry-gate for token refresh and updated backoff defaults. linking MR: https://git.redwood/sdks/merge/802 (will summarize in PR).

olivia: nice — i've updated the sampleapp branch to include idempotency keys and README blurb, will open a small docs PR after CI passes.


dx-bot: CI passed for sampleapp branch (build 421) :white_check_mark:

sam: once merged let's ship a tiny deprecation note for apps relying on old naive behavior and provide migration steps. also add an integration test that simulates 429 during token refresh.

olivia: yea i'll add the integration test to sampleapp harness. thanks team :tada:
